name: family-tree-editor
description: client-side family tree viewer and editor for the attu project wiki

scripts.postinstall: test -d .githooks && git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.trees-server:setup: cd apps/server && env -u VIRTUAL_ENV uv sync
scripts.lint:no-hyperbolic-imports: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');try{const o=execSync('grep -rEn \"from .*engines/hyperbolic-lr\" apps/tree-editor/src/lib/layout/engines/family-view/ 2>/dev/null',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();if(o){console.error('relationship-vocabulary main wave forbids importing from engines/hyperbolic-lr (Wave 2 deferral):\n'+o);process.exit(1)}}catch(e){if(e.status&&e.status!==1){throw e}}"
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:no-hyperbolic-imports && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm trees-server:setup && pnpm trees-server:lint && pnpm trees-server:test
